articles.title: Here's what SpaceX's IPO means for its $1.3 billion bitcoin reserve
articles.snippet: The largest company on public markets now holds bitcoin as a treasury reserve, not as a business model. Its first earnings cycles will test which version of corporate crypto survives a bear market.

articles.title: Bitcoin surfs SpaceX IPO at $64K as trader warns key BTC price support may crumble
articles.snippet: Bitcoin hit $64,000 as SpaceX launched a record-breaking IPO and US-Iran peace deal hopes continued to grow, but doubts over BTC price support remained.

articles.title: AI Agents Still Can't Stop Prompt Injection Attacks, Researchers Warn
articles.snippet: A new benchmark study found AI agents remain vulnerable to prompt injection attacks as companies increasingly roll out the technology to the public.

articles.title: Microsoft President Asks Graduates to Stop Fearing AI and Start Adapting
articles.snippet: Brad Smith published a 3,000-word essay urging empathy for graduates booing AI at commencements. The same week, Microsoft's CFO confirmed headcount will keep shrinking.
